# GenuDo

> GenuDo is an AI workforce platform for businesses in Egypt and the Middle East. It gives you AI employees (Aaref for sales, Adnan for customer support and ROZ for WhatsApp quality control) that answer customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and website chat in Arabic dialects and other languages, follow up, book meetings and update your CRM, while your team stays in control.

Also known as: Genudo, جينـو دو. Mascot and guide: GENU (جينـو).
The site is published in Egyptian Arabic (primary, `/ar-EG`) and English (`/en`). Base URL: https://genudo.ai
Full fact sheet and FAQ for AI systems: https://genudo.ai/llms-full.txt

## Start here
- [What is an AI workforce?](https://genudo.ai/en/ai-workforce): Definition of AI employees, how they differ from chatbots, what they do, and how to keep control.
- [How GenuDo works](https://genudo.ai/en/how-it-works): From first message to booked meeting: AI employees, stages, follow-ups, your own knowledge, capped AI cost, channels and analytics.
- [Who is GENU](https://genudo.ai/en/who-is-genu): The guide to your AI workforce and the AI employee family.

## AI employees
- [Aaref, AI sales employee](https://genudo.ai/en/sol-sales-agent): Answers every inquiry, qualifies leads, follows up with quiet ones, books meetings and updates your CRM.
- [Adnan, AI customer support employee](https://genudo.ai/en/sol-customer-service): Answers customers from your own knowledge and policies any hour and hands complex cases to your team (Zoho Desk / Zendesk).
- [ROZ, AI quality control for WhatsApp](https://genudo.ai/en/sol-operations): Reviews your team's WhatsApp conversations, flags slow replies, stalled deals and missed opportunities.

## By industry
- [Marketing agencies](https://genudo.ai/en/ind-marketing): Every paid lead answered and qualified.
- [Clinics](https://genudo.ai/en/ind-clinics): Appointment booking and patient questions any hour (scheduling and admin, not diagnosis).
- [E-learning and academies](https://genudo.ai/en/ind-elearning): Course inquiries turned into enrolments.
- [Gyms and fitness](https://genudo.ai/en/ind-fitness): Trial bookings and membership questions on WhatsApp.
- [Hospitality and tourism](https://genudo.ai/en/ind-hospitality): Booking requests answered across time zones.
- [Camps and events](https://genudo.ai/en/ind-camps-events): Registration peaks handled without temporary staff.
